newsitem.title: USA: Summers encouraged by Mexico's economic progress.
newsitem.headline: Summers encouraged by Mexico's economic progress.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers Thursday said he was encouraged by Mexico's progress but that there were still problems to be dealt with.
In a press briefing, Summers said "I am encouraged by the economic performance of Mexico over the last year."
He said that in terms of economic growth, bringing down the inflation rate and maintaining stability in financial markets, "more has been achieved than many observers had expected."
At the same time, he said there were difficult economic issues that remain in Mexico, including issues in the financial sector.
He also said it was important for Mexico to make sure that all its citizens have fair opportunity.
"We are encouraged by what has happened and are very encouraged by the commitment and steadfastness of the Mexican authorities to remain on the path of reform," he said.
